The infection which causes/gums to bleed and teeth to fall out/results from the build-up of/a particular bacteria that is common to most mouths.

options.html: The infection which causes

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. Scarcely had I reached the terrace to water my plants ______ two monkeys jumped in front of me.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Scarcely had I reached the terrace to water my plants ______ two monkeys jumped in front of me.
questions.solution: When' should be used because in the entire context, the sentence is discussing a situation that happens almost immediately. Here, through "Scarcely had I reached the terrace to water my plants ______ two monkeys jumped in front of me.", it portrays that immediate sequence of events, where one action follows another almost instantaneously. Thus, "when" would be the most appropriate choice.
